messages:
Maya: Heads up — a subset of new onboarders are failing the final SSO webhook auth during tenant provisioning. Seeing 401s from the VPC connector since 08:03 PT. This blocks provisioning and some customers can’t finish setup. Notifying here so CS + eng can coordinate.

Raj: deploy-bot alerted at 07:48 with a rise in auth failures. I opened a bridge and tagged infra. Error pattern looks like a routing rule mismatch, not customer keys.

deploy-bot: [alert] 401 spikes on /v1/onboard/webhook — 07:48 -> +120% request failures

Sophie: I’m on it — we pushed a routing tweak in the prod rollout at 07:45 that could’ve impacted the VPC route table. Starting rollback now, ETA ~25-30m. Will post logs once started.

Maya: Thanks. I’ll start drafting an affected-customer note. Can someone drop the list of active onboarding tenants? We should be specific about affected steps and proposed mitigations.

Daniel: @Maya I’ll pull the current onboarding queue and flag renewal-risk accounts. Send me the comm text and I’ll tailor for top-10 priority accounts.

Maya: Quick account snapshot (12 tenants showing blocking auth):
- acct-orion (onboarding: integration step)
- acct-lyra (waiting SSO callback)
- acct-cedar (failed provisioning x3)
- acct-kumo (high-touch trial)
- acct-nova (dedicated, in final setup)
(see full CSV uploaded to #cs-files)

Omar: I’m looping in the renewal owners for acct-kumo and acct-nova — both are in late-stage discussions. We'll treat them as high touch; please include a personal outreach line in the comm.

Maya: Draft comm (short):
"Hi — we’re investigating an internal routing issue that may prevent completion of onboarding. We apologize for the disruption. Our engineers are rolling back a recent change; we expect services to be restored within 30 minutes. If you’re blocked, reply here and we’ll jump on a call. We’ll follow up with an RCA and offering a 1-month credit for impacted onboarding windows. Short feedback form: https://redwood.example/impacted-onboard-feedback"

Daniel: Clean and solid. Add a sentence directing high-touch customers to their AE for immediate help. Also note the credit is automatic for tenants that hit the blocker.

Sophie: Rollback started 08:18 PT. I’ve reverted the routing rule and kicked a targeted redeploy to the VPC connector. Watching logs — will update in 5.

Raj: Errors dropping — from ~30% to 6% failed calls in the last 3 minutes. Monitoring tail latency and auth success.

Maya: I’ll send the comm to affected contacts now (short note + optional call link). Also scheduling an enablement office hour Wednesday 10am PT for any teams that need help finishing onboarding; will include a quick checklist and live Q&A.

Omar: I’ve DM'd acct-kumo AE to offer an immediate call and credited their account hold in the CRM. Renewal owner acknowledged.

Sophie: All checks green at 08:42 PT. No new 401s for 10m, infra metrics normalized. I’ll prepare a short internal postmortem with timeline and the config diff.

Daniel: Thanks all. CS action items:
- Maya: send outbound comm and post follow-up note into account threads (done)
- Maya/Daniel: tag renewal-risk accounts and run churn-risk survey
- Sophie/Raj: share RCA and mitigation steps for the CS playbook
- Omar: confirm AE outreaches completed

Maya: Sent comm at 08:45 PT to the affected list and pasted copy in customer threads. Customers will get the RCA and credit update when Sophie shares the postmortem.

Maya: Capture feedback plan — short survey link in comm + option for a 15-min call. I’ll synthesize responses and highlight any common pain points for product.

Sophie: Posting RCA draft in #eng-runtime in 30m; will include exact timeline, root cause (routing rule collision), and the preventive rollout check we’re adding.

Raj: Closing bridge in 1h once we confirm no regression. Leaving monitoring alarms at tighter thresholds for 72h.

Daniel: I’ll add an account-health flag to our dashboard so renewals see the event and any credits applied. Great cross-team response — please drop any follow-ups in this thread.

Maya: Final note — we’ve scheduled a proactive enablement drop-in Wed 10am PT and will offer tailored sessions for the three highest-risk renewals. Thanks everyone :pray:
